assets.title: 사업장 명부 두 파일과 그 모든 지난 판 받기
assets.description: 국민연금 가입 사업장 내역(15083277, 매월)과 고용·산재보험 가입 현황(15002150, 매년)을 파일마다 자기 작업이 하루 한 번 받는다: 포털의 메타데이터가 이름 짓는 지금 파일이 새것이면 받고, 데이터셋 쪽의 주기성 과거 데이터 목록에서 아직 묻지 않은 지난 판을 오래된 것부터 실행마다 상한까지 받아 Bronze(datagokr__<dataset_slug>)에 받은 그대로 한 번 쓴다(루트 ADR-0604). Silver 는 아직 없다.

jobs.description: 국민연금공단 국민연금 가입 사업장 내역 (data.go.kr 15083277; root ADR-0604; scripts/ops/data-go-kr-file-collect.sh pension-workplace, the publisher's collect-data-go-kr-file-data): the month's file when the portal's metadata names a new one, and the earlier months the dataset page still lists, oldest first, at most past_editions.max_per_run (20) a run, each landed in Bronze (datagokr__pension_workplace) as received and recorded as it is asked. Measured 2026-11-22: the current file is one CP949 CSV of about 115 MB (589,413 workplaces) and 130 earlier months are listed (2015-12..2026-09, 81 MB to 121 MB, 12,984 MB together), so the history lands in seven runs; after it, a run is two requests (the metadata and the list) and one file a month. Bronze only: no Silver table yet.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-23, root ADR-0604); sized as the collector holds one file in memory and one more copy while it commits it: the largest edition of the two files this unit collects is 526 MB (the 2021 고용·산재 zip, measured 2026-11-22), so about 1.1 GB at the most, and an NPS month about 115 MB; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: runs no DuckDB stage (none of the publisher's stage commands is in its unit's scripts), so the stage's open check never reads it; 1G is its share of a task's disk on AWS beside its state_paths.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the 2026-11-22 measurement and the file collector's own: 21 files of at most 121 MB (the current one and 20 earlier months, 2.5 GB at the most), each downloaded at about 6 MB/s (the 349 MB 상가 zip in 59 s, ADR-0401) and written to Bronze at about the same, plus two requests' 5 s spacing each: about 21 x 50 s = 1,050 s, rounded up to 1,500 s

expected_outcome.basis: the file is released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1,080 h) plus one daily turn; until the history is landed every run lands earlier months.

jobs.description: 근로복지공단 고용·산재보험 가입 현황 (data.go.kr 15002150; root ADR-0604; scripts/ops/data-go-kr-file-collect.sh employment-insurance-workplace, the publisher's collect-data-go-kr-file-data): the year's file when the portal's metadata names a new one, and the earlier editions the dataset page still lists, oldest registered first, at most past_editions.max_per_run (4) a run, each landed in Bronze (datagokr__employment_insurance_workplace) as received, a zip or a CSV as it arrives, and recorded as it is asked. Measured 2026-11-22: the current file is a zip of 134 MB (three CSVs, 2,607,699 workplaces, the full business number) and 16 earlier editions are listed (14 zips and 2 CSVs, 14 MB to 526 MB, 2,756 MB together), so the history lands in four runs; after it, a run is two requests and one file a year. Bronze only: no Silver table yet.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-23, root ADR-0604); sized as the collector holds one file in memory and one more copy while it commits it: the largest edition is 526 MB (the 2021 zip, measured 2026-11-22), so about 1.1 GB at the most; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: runs no DuckDB stage (none of the publisher's stage commands is in its unit's scripts), so the stage's open check never reads it; 1G is its share of a task's disk on AWS beside its state_paths.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the 2026-11-22 measurement and the file collector's own: the current 134 MB zip and four earlier editions (at most the four largest, 1,614 MB together), each downloaded at about 6 MB/s (the 349 MB 상가 zip in 59 s, ADR-0401) and written to Bronze at about the same: at most about 1,750 MB x 2 / 6 MB/s = 583 s plus the spacing, rounded up to 900 s

expected_outcome.basis: the file is released yearly (expected_cadence yearly, 10,200 h) plus one daily turn; until the history is landed every run lands earlier editions.
